about: Announced lineups for festivals in the shared catalog. Add an entry when a festival announces its lineup, deploy, then run Seed Festival Lineups on the admin page (dry run first). Format and rules: netlify/functions/lib/festivalLineupSeed.js. Example entry: { "seedKey": "bonnaroo-2027", "artists": ["Headliner", "Second Act"], "sourceUrl": "https://www.bonnaroo.com/lineup" }
